definition: Power stratification of the 7 major factions in the Xiyouji world: nominal power comes from Heaven’s investiture · actual power from resource control · influence from overall strength
scoring_criteria: Influence scored 0-10: 10 = top of the Three Realms · 8-9 = regional dominance · 6-7 = mid-tier power · 4-5 = marginal power · 0-3 = weak group

factions.name: Heaven
factions.power_gap: Nominal power 10 > actual power 9 · gap of 1 · because Lingshan is effectively independent — Tathāgata nominally submits but in practice does not pay court

factions.name: Lingshan
factions.power_gap: Actual power 10 > nominal power 8 · gap of 2 · nominally under Heaven’s jurisdiction · in practice independently runs the pilgrimage project

factions.name: Underworld
factions.leader: Ten Kings of Hell (supervised by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva)
factions.power_gap: Nominal power 7 > actual power 6 · gap of 1 · Wukong tampering with the Book of Life and Death exposes weak enforcement

factions.name: Mortal Realm
factions.power_gap: Nominal power 6 > actual power 5 · gap of 1 · mortal monarchy is invested by Heaven · yet is in practice independent

factions.name: Demon Realm
factions.leader: No unified leadership (Bull Demon King is the strongest)
factions.power_gap: Actual power 7 > nominal power 2 · gap of 5 · the largest gap · demons are strong in fact but weak in name · hence often besieged by Heaven

factions.name: Aquatic Tribes
factions.leader: Dragon Kings of the Four Seas
factions.power_gap: Actual power = nominal power = 5 · balanced · the execution of the Jing River Dragon King is a warning to establish authority · the aquatic tribes overall obey Heaven

factions.name: Loose Immortals
factions.power_gap: Actual power 7 > nominal power 4 · gap of 3 · loose immortals are strong but not invested · hence outside the system

structure_analysis.balance_pattern: Heaven and Lingshan are both T0 · Heaven has the highest nominal power · Lingshan the highest actual power · forming a dual-center co-governance
structure_analysis.biggest_power_gap: Demon Realm (actual 7 vs nominal 2 · gap of 5) · hence the demons are rebels against the system
structure_analysis.smallest_power_gap: Aquatic Tribes (actual = nominal = 5) · fully submissive to the system

structure_insights: Heaven and Lingshan tie for first · both influence 10 · but Heaven’s nominal power is high and Lingshan’s actual power is high
Demon Realm actual power 7 · nominal 2 · the largest gap · the root of rebellion against the system
Loose immortals are strong (actual 7) but low in nominal power (4) · Patriarch Bodhi lives in seclusion · Zhenyuan Daxian becomes Wukong’s sworn brother
Underworld nominal 7 · actual 6 · the tampered Book of Life and Death exposes governance gaps
Mortal Realm nominal 6 · actual 5 · the Great Tang is strong but invested by Heaven
Aquatic Tribes fully submissive · the Jing River Dragon King was executed as a scapegoat for Heaven to assert authority
